Hello, everyone!
We've got a small update for our PC players.
You can now fully rebind your controls.
Whether you're left-handed, prefer a custom layout, or just like your controls set up a certain way, you can now tailor the keyboard & mouse or gamepad bindings to match your playstyle.
The update is available on Steam right now.
Added the ability to remap controls in Settings
Every action supports both a primary and a secondary input, giving you more flexibility to set up controls the way that feels most comfortable
Fixed a hidden branching dialogue with the Mystery Man when giving him Ice Cream. The dialogue now only triggers on the sixth shift if Makoto previously brought him Ice Cream
Fixed a rare issue where player could win two Golden Assam capsule toys
Fixed an issue with mouse scrolling in Settings
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951606/52e38851e69217ad27e92287305c83ecca1093ee.png"]
Hello everyone!

We've been watching your streams, reading through bug reports, and following the discussions across all our channels. These insights help us spot issues, prioritize improvements, and make inKONBINI even better.

Based on your feedback, we've added an option to reset progress on the current shift and Korean language support. We've also improved how Makoto navigates around obstacles, making movement through the store smoother and more reliable.

As always, we've included a number of bug fixes and general improvements as well. These updates are available on Steam right now and will be coming to consoles very soon. Check out the full patch notes below!
Added “Reset Shift” feature
Players can now reset their current progress on each night back to the beginning of the shift. “Reset Shift” option will appear in the pause menu only if the shift was started after the patch update
Improved Collision & Pathfinding
Players could occasionally get stuck in narrow passages, most notably between the Main Area and Storage Area as well as in several other spots, especially while carrying boxes
Makoto will now automatically navigate around nearby obstacles more smoothly, reducing the chance of getting stuck and making movement feel more natural
Fixed a bug on the third shift where a taxi could appear while Naomi and Makoto were commenting that there was no taxi in sight
Fixed an issue where improper text would be written down in Makoto's Notepad
Added full Korean language support
Fixed misspels and missing lines in Japanese, English, German, and Russian
Fixed Spanish localization for conversation with Satoshi outside the store on the 5th shift

Added "Gameplay Center Dot Reticle" feature to consoles - turning it on in Accessibility settings makes a small dot appear at the center of the screen that would help players better navigate and interact with objects
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951606/4874749a6ffecf6c900a97efe822f727a006b3b5.png"]
Hello everyone!
We’ve been listening to your feedback and addressing bugs - and now the first batch of improvements for inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories is finally here.
By popular demand, we’ve added an ability to WALK FASTER. We’ve also fixed a wide range of bugs and issues. You can check out the full patch notes below.
The patch is available now on Steam and will roll out to all consoles very soon!
Added an ability to WALK FASTER. To turn this on, please open Settings. In "GENERAL" under Accessibility switch "Sprint Button" to "On" and use a corresponding button during gameplay
Improved Boxes stacking

now if you take the box with Toy Capsules or the box with Marketing Materials while holding a box with products in your hands, the products will not move to the stack of boxes in the Storage Room (since many players weren't able to find the products in the stack of boxes) - the product box will instead be placed in the nearest spot on the floor in the Main Area so that it's easy to find
If you picked up Toy Capsule/Marketing Materials box while holding an empty box, it'll still go to the stack of empty boxes in the Storage Room
Fixed a critical bug where the order in which customers/delivery arrive would mix up if player pressed "I" button on a keyboard
Fixed an issue with Mystery Man on the sixth shift where the dialogue near Freezer wouldn't start properly resulting in a critical bug
Fixed a bug where Satoshi could arrive when the journalist asks to order taxi
Fixed an issue where event with recommending sale items to Mystery Man on the second shift was triggering after the payment is already completed
Fixed a bug causing Satoshi to remain in the store after checkout on 2nd and 3rd shift
Fixed a progression bug caused by Satoshi entering while selecting an extra bag for the Mystery Man on the 5th shift

In a conversation with Delivery Service on the third shift regarding ordering Gonseung Coffee text now says "order 1 box", because Makoto can't order 2 boxes that night. Text was changed for all languages
Improved object targeting responsiveness when interacting with the box of Capsule Toys
Fixed an issue where you could interact with Sink from behind the counter
Improved object targeting when interacting with the Vase on the sixth shift
Fixed an issue where controls would stop working if player started checking customer out and opening text log at the same time
Fixed an issue where players couldn't close Notepad after opening it during checkout cutscene before scanning products
Fixed an issue where players weren't able to interact with Chief on the 5th shift
Fixed an issue for slower Text Speed options where lines from some cutscenes would cut off before they were even typed, not allowing players to read the text properly
Fixed a bug where "Decrease/Increase" input would appear in Settings after changing Controller Style
Added Accessibility options in "Settings"
Fixed a bug where dynamic panel would constantly move after exiting interactions
Fixed a bug that caused achievement names to be displayed incorrectly (it showed achievement that you unlocked first during that play session)
Fixed misspels in English and Russian
Fixed an issue where Makoto could clip into one of the boxes in the Storage Area on the last night shift
Fixed an issue where some SFX effects (like Satoshi talking about great tea martial artists on the 2nd shift) were not linked to SFX slider which resulted in louder sounds than intended
Added additional names to Credits section
Fixed an issue with accessing DLC on Xbox
Added localized Achievement names for Xbox
